name: Bolezn
source:
A high school student dreams from the perspective of a serial killer terrorizing his hometown. He wants to help the police catch the monster, but doing so may put him in the killer’s shoes.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4579890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名高中生从连环杀手的角度进行梦想，威胁他的家乡。他想帮助警方抓住怪物，但这样做可能会让他陷入杀手的境地。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4579890/]Steam[/url]]
